rationale: Cross-package validation first requires the independently reconstructed subject-visit analysis rows to match the primary MMRM analysis population and values, then compares quantities that should agree under mathematically equivalent REML unstructured marginal models. Degrees of freedom and p-values are deliberately excluded because the primary mmrm analysis uses Satterthwaite inference whereas the nlme reconstruction is used for analysis-population, point-estimate and model-based-SE validation.
evidence_boundary: Independent re-programming exercise by the portfolio author using a distinct R package, independent analysis-row reconstruction and independent contrast construction. This is not formal independent second-programmer validation, sponsor validation, or regulatory production QC.
